component.name: Seira
component.summary: Your own team of AI agents in one chat app

description.p: Seira is a local-first chat app for running a team of AI agents. Each bot has its own conversations, files and tools, and your data stays on your computer.
Seira runs the AI agent programs that you already use, such as Claude, Codex and Gemini. It starts them from this app and shows their work in one chat.

ul.li: Chat with many bots and keep each conversation apart.
Approve or refuse what a bot wants to do before it does it.
Connect apps, files and cloud computers to your bots.

description.p: The Flatpak package starts agent programs on your computer, outside the Flatpak sandbox. Install these programs on your computer first. Seira does not include them.
